The first of the reformed Clanling groups to arrive was the only one that went east. There, the spiders were marching at night when they saw the glowing lights in the distance. It was a ship, bound towards the coast off Reginapolis for trading. Just as that ship was rolling by, another ship was going by, this one headed in the other direction towards the Schryke trading posts. The Fulcrid had never really seen these ships before, and were mystified by how they glowed with light, swarmed with activity, and glided across the surface of the water. This pause gave them time to realize the beautiful sands they were working on, a break in the rocky shores they were accustomed to seeing. Because of the importance of this beach, and the proximity at which the ships came, the Fulcrid settled their settlement and called it Speculamos, due to the passing nature of all the ships. From the days of construction onward, the Fulcrid would pause to watch the ships as they passed by, until the activity became so regular that they ceased.

The second Clanling group was walking up north along the coast, when they started going up towards an incline in the rocky coast. Once at the peak, the Fulcrid looked down, they were surprised to see that the color of the rocks on the cliff weren't the usual black and gray color, but these were a sparkling white. The Fulcrud had a taste, only to find out that the stone was so hard, they had trouble breaking it off. Now many of these settler had become quite traumatized by the Sentinel invasion, and thus wanted to found a settlement that was easily defensible. So upon finding this high, hard, and defensible cliff face, they immediately got to setting up the foundations for the Anchor Point.

[Locations of the new settlements are marked with black and red dots.](https://i.sli.mg/dyEBkN.jpg)

But as the Clanling continued to settle and repair their habitations, the Queen was pondering. She was wondering what could be done to physically show the unification between the Fulcrid and the Chlora? Aha! The Queen remembered when she first marched her army off to "meet" them. She remembers how difficult it was to pass through the tree filled terrain. So in order to make travelling, and thus partnership, between the two peoples easier, why not build a path in the forest! A path of webs can be built through the forests, from Reginapolis to the Tree of Life. It would be perfect!

The Queen was so excited by this idea, that she immediately got to work thinking about how many spider to organize for the job, and how the Queen would instruct the leaders on how to build these new roads. if only she didn't give the scale away! Now all the addition has to be done on stone tablets of all things!
